description:
Anchorages already analysed nearby, re-scored for comfort over the next
    three nights against the real forecast wind and swell.

    Only spots whose full shelter profile is already in Solano's shared cache are
    considered — work other users' analyses have already paid for. Each is scored
    per night (18:00 to 10:00 local) on the worst hour of the window, which is
    the conservative reading you want for a night at anchor: swell weighs 0.70,
    wind 0.30, because swell is what makes a boat roll.

    Empty result means nobody has analysed an anchorage around this point yet,
    not that there is none — use `analyze_anchorage` on a precise spot to add
    one, or open the app to sweep the area.

    Cheap by construction: no topography download, two forecast calls.
name: find_known_anchorages
title: Sheltered anchorages nearby
